description: This file defines an interface IRelationalStorage for interacting with relational databases within the Orleans project. It includes method signatures for executing queries and commands asynchronously, and provides detailed documentation and example usage.

classes.name: IRelationalStorage
classes.description: An interface representing a common abstraction for relational database operations, including methods for reading data asynchronously and executing commands, parameterized with generics for result types.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a query expected to return results, transforming IDataRecord results into a specified TResult type via a selector function, supporting multiple result sets and cancellation.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a non-query command such as INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL statements, returning the number of affected rows.
